newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks move up on back of blue chip.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks move up on back of blue chip.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were higher in Friday morning trade, led by a sharp rise in a highly capitalised blue chips, brokers said.

The all share index was 9.4 points up at 743.20 at 0500 GMT, on turnover of 16.4 million rupees. The blue chip Hayleys Ltd rose 10 rupees to 245 along with Kegalle Plantations two to 34, Union Assurance 3.50 to 53.
"Highly capitalised blue chips have a big impact on the all share index and the Hayleys gain was largely responsible for taking the index up," said a broker who declined to be identified.
